test_cases.question: How frequently must the European Data Protection Board publish reports on data protection?
test_cases.answer: The Board shall draw up an annual report regarding the protection of natural persons with regard to processing in the Union and, where relevant, in third countries and international organisations.
test_cases.supporting_quote: The Board shall draw up an annual report regarding the protection of natural persons with regard to processing in the Union and, where relevant, in third countries and international organisations

test_cases.question: Who receives the Board's annual data protection report and is it publicly available?
test_cases.answer: The report shall be made public and be transmitted to the European Parliament, to the Council, and to the Commission.
test_cases.supporting_quote: The report shall be made public and be transmitted to the European Parliament, to the Council and to the Commission

test_cases.question: What specific content must be included in the Board's annual report?
test_cases.answer: The annual report shall include a review of the practical application of the guidelines, recommendations and best practices referred to in point (l) of Article 70(1). This ensures accountability for how EDPB guidance is being implemented in practice.
test_cases.supporting_quote: The annual report shall include a review of the practical application of the guidelines, recommendations and best practices referred to in point (l)

coverage.71(1): Test case 1 - Annual report on protection in Union and third countries
coverage.71(2) recipients: Test case 2 - Parliament, Council, Commission + made public
coverage.71(2) content: Test case 3 - Review of practical application of guidelines

b2b_relevance: LOW-MEDIUM - Article 71 requires EDPB to report annually on: (1) How GDPR is working in practice, (2) How guidelines are being applied. These reports are PUBLIC and useful for: understanding enforcement trends, seeing how EDPB guidance is being implemented, and benchmarking your compliance approach against practical application findings.
